desc: **Task 1:** Implement the core counting logic inside `countSubstrings` using the described O(9·n) algorithm.
**Task 2:** Verify the algorithm on the provided examples and a few additional edge cases (e.g., all zeros, single character, max length random string) to ensure correctness and performance.
**Task 3:** Write a brief comment/docstring explaining the logic and confirm that the solution runs within the O(n) time and O(1) extra space constraints.
